question: According to the Census 2011, which group of seven sister states has the highest literacy rate?
solution: The correct answer is __**Mizoram and Tripura**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • According to the 2011 census, **Mizoram and Tripura had the highest literacy rate among the Seven Sister states of India. ** • The **literacy rate in Mizoram was 91.33% in 2011, with 93.35% of males and 89.27% of females literate**. • The literacy rate in **Tripura was 87.75% in 2011. ** • The Seven Sister states **of India are Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, and Tripura**
